description: This file defines a class FakeWebCrypto with methods for cryptographic operations, including UUID generation, encoding, hashing, encryption, and key management, used for mocking web crypto functionalities in tests.

classes.name: FakeWebCrypto
classes.description: A mock implementation of web cryptography functions for testing purposes.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Placeholder for deinitialization logic.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Placeholder for initialization logic.

methods.name: randomString
methods.description: Generates a random alphanumeric string of specified length.

methods.name: generateUUIDSync
methods.description: Synchronously generates a UUID using crypto or fallback to timestamp and Math.random.

methods.name: generateUUID
methods.description: Alias for generateUUIDSync.

methods.name: timingSafeEqual
methods.description: Performs a timing-safe equality check.

methods.name: base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes text to base64.

methods.name: base64URLEncode
methods.description: Encodes text to base64 URL-safe string.

methods.name: base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes base64 string to text.

methods.name: pbkdf2
methods.description: Mocks PBKDF2 key derivation, returns base64 of concatenated inputs.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a random key of specified bits.

methods.name: aes256CbcEncrypt
methods.description: Mocks AES-256-CBC encryption, returns base64 of JSON string.

methods.name: aes256CbcDecrypt
methods.description: Mocks AES-256-CBC decryption, returns plaintext if key and iv match.

methods.name: hmac256
methods.description: Mocks HMAC-SHA256, returns base64 of message concatenated with key.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Calls external SNWebCrypto.sha256 method.

methods.name: hmac1
methods.description: Mocks HMAC-SHA1, returns base64 of message concatenated with key.

methods.name: unsafeSha1
methods.description: Mocks SHA1 hash, returns base64 of text.

methods.name: argon2
methods.description: Mocks Argon2 key derivation, returns repeated base64-encoded password.

methods.name: xchacha20Encrypt
methods.description: Mocks XChaCha20 encryption, returns base64 of JSON string.

methods.name: xchacha20Decrypt
methods.description: Mocks XChaCha20 decryption, returns plaintext if data matches.

methods.name: sodiumCryptoBoxEasyEncrypt
methods.description: Mocks NaCl crypto box encryption, returns base64 of JSON string.

methods.name: sodiumCryptoBoxEasyDecrypt
methods.description: Mocks NaCl crypto box decryption, returns message if data matches.

methods.name: sodiumCryptoBoxGenerateKeypair
methods.description: Mocks keypair generation, returns object with public and private keys.

methods.name: generateOtpSecret
methods.description: Returns a fixed OTP secret string.

methods.name: totpToken
methods.description: Returns a fixed TOTP token string.
